$comment: Who does the work. Peoples set a player's baseline (die size, terrain comfort, food quirks, how they hold mana). Professions are individual workers upgraded at a guildhall - they unlock recipes that plain workers cannot run. manaStorage.innate is how much mana a body of that people can hold with no talisman; everyone can hold more in a talisman (items.json, class talisman).

peoples.name: Humans
peoples.summary: No edges and no gaps. Cheapest buildings, widest recipe access.

traits.name: Adaptable
traits.effect: Ignore the first terrain effort penalty each round.

traits.name: Builders
traits.effect: All housing costs 1 less of its bulkiest material.

manaStorage.note: A human body holds no mana. Every drop lives in a talisman.

peoples.name: Dwarves
peoples.summary: Underground and metallurgy. Slow above ground, unmatched below it.

traits.name: Deep Delvers
traits.effect: Roll d8 instead of d6 for any worker allocated to a mine or quarry.

traits.name: Smiths
traits.effect: Forge Tool and Make Jewellery cost 1 fewer hour.

traits.name: Surefooted
traits.effect: Mountain and hills tiles cost 1 less to move through, minimum 1.

traits.name: Thirsty
traits.effect: A dwarf fed mead rolls one die size up next round.

traits.name: Sun-shy
traits.effect: -1 effort for any dwarf allocated to a farm, orchard or vineyard.

manaStorage.note: Dwarves distrust mana in the flesh and keep it in worked metal, where it belongs.

peoples.name: Elves
peoples.summary: Forest, textiles and the arcane. Terrible miners, superb weavers.

traits.name: Woodwise
traits.effect: Forage and Harvest Arcane Herbs yield double.

traits.name: Fine Hands
traits.effect: Weave Fine Cloth produces 2 instead of 1.

traits.name: Longstriders
traits.effect: Forest tiles cost 1 to move through.

traits.name: Will Not Delve
traits.effect: Elves cannot be allocated to a mana vein, and roll d4 in any other mine.

manaStorage.note: An elf may hold up to 3 mana in the body; anything beyond that needs a talisman like everyone else.

traits.name: Many Hands
traits.effect: Start with one extra worker, and huts cost 1 log.

traits.name: Green Fingers
traits.effect: All crops mature one round faster, minimum 1.

traits.name: Second Breakfast
traits.effect: A halfling town pays 2 extra food every Feeding phase, however many halflings live in it.

manaStorage.note: Halflings hold no mana and are privately relieved about it.

peoples.name: Orcs
peoples.summary: Enormous output, no patience. Built for a short, aggressive game.

traits.name: Hard on Tools
traits.effect: Tools take 2 wear per effort hour instead of 1.

traits.name: Raiders
traits.effect: +1 combat die when attacking, and loot 40% instead of 25%.

traits.name: Crude Craft
traits.effect: Cannot build tier-3 or tier-4 buildings without capturing one first.

manaStorage.note: An orc who wants mana takes a talisman from someone who had one.

workerTypes.name: Worker
workerTypes.summary: The basic unit of labour. One effort die per round, one food per round.

workerTypes.name: Specialist
workerTypes.summary: A worker trained in a profession. Same dice, but unlocks gated recipes and adds a bonus at its own building.

workerTypes.name: Soldier
workerTypes.summary: A worker under arms. Produces no effort, eats normally, fights.

professions.name: Smith
professions.bonus: +1 output on any recipe run at a blacksmith.

professions.name: Carpenter
professions.bonus: Build-points from this worker count double on timber buildings.

professions.name: Brewer
professions.bonus: +1 barrel of output on Brew Ale, Brew Mead and Make Wine.

professions.name: Merchant
professions.bonus: Removes the market spread in this town, and may broker a trade between two other players for a 10% cut.

professions.name: Alchemist
professions.bonus: Potions brewed here last one extra round.

professions.name: Healer
professions.bonus: Illness event cards cost this healer's town one worker fewer, and characters resting at this town's inn heal +1 per round.
professions.notes: Physician, medic, hedge-witch, bone-setter - the title varies by people, the profession is the same. The character deck carries named examples.

professions.name: Miner
professions.bonus: +1 output on any mining recipe, and picks wear half as fast in this worker's hands.

professions.name: Engineer
professions.bonus: Lay Rail costs 1 less build-point per tile, and trains this player runs need 1 less coal per tile.
